title: Insured Portal Window Lengths on Appointment Series
content:
Scheduling standard — the span of calendar days from the booking date within which an insured portal booking on an Appointment Series counts its standing appointments.

**Rule.** The insured portal window is 21 calendar days where the series shows two or more missed-visit fees assessed in the two months up to the booking date (an entry counts when fewer than two whole months separate its date from the booking date), 28 calendar days where it shows exactly one such fee, and the booking horizon of the series' format where it shows none; in every case the window still ends no later than the series end date.

**What is counted.** The missed-visit fee entries on the series — late-cancellation and no-show fee entries alike — by the date each was assessed.

| Missed-visit fee entries on the series in the two months up to the booking date | Insured portal window |
|---|---|
| two or more | 21 calendar days |
| exactly one | 28 calendar days |
| none | the format's booking horizon (below) |

| Visit format | Booking horizon |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 28 calendar days |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 56 calendar days |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 42 calendar days |

**Edge of the two months (hypothetical dates, booking on 20 August).** A fee entry dated 21 June counts; one dated 20 June does not.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series with one fee entry in the period and an end date 60 days away has a 28-day window; with the end date 25 days away, the window still ends on the series end date.
